## **What is Hericium Erinaceus Extract ?**  
Hericium erinaceus extract (Lions mane polysaccharide) is made from the Fruitting body or Mycelium of hericium erinaceus (Lions Mane Mushroom). **Hericium Erinaceus Extract polysaccharides** is an effective active component extracted from the fruit body of high quality hericius ericius. The main components of hericius ericius are polysaccharides and hericiin. Hericium erinaceus polysaccharide extracted from hot water has obvious inhibitory effect on mouse sarcoma 180 and ascites cancer, and has the function of assisting digestion and promoting the five viscera. It has good curative effect on chronic gastritis, duodenal ulcer and other digestive diseases, and can improve human immunity.

**Hericium Erinaceus ExtractMain Function**  
1\. Anti-inflammatory and anti-ulcer: Hericium ericium extract can treat gastric mucosal injury and chronic atrophic gastritis, and can significantly improve the eradication rate of helicobacter pylori and ulcer healing rate.  
2\. Anti-tumor: the fruiting body extract and mycelium extract of ericium mushroom play an important role in anti-tumor.  
3\. Lowering blood sugar: The mycelium extract of herinaceus erinaceus can counteract the hyperglycemia caused by alloxacil. The mechanism of action may be that herinaceus erinaceus polysaccharide binds to specific receptors on the cell membrane, transfers information to mitochondria through cyclic adenosine phosphate, improves the activity of the enzyme system of glucose metabolism, thus speeding up the oxidative decomposition of sugar and achieving the purpose of lowering blood sugar.
